question:
Calculate personal income from the following data.

I. National Income = ₹ 1,000

II. Corporate tax = ₹ 10

III. Subsidy = ₹ 5

IV. Undistributed profit = ₹ 15

V. Rent= ₹ 15
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹ 980**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **₹ 980** is the calculated personal income based on the given data.
 
• Personal Income is calculated using the formula:
 
 
• Personal Income = National Income - Corporate Tax - Undistributed Profits + Subsidies
 
 
 
• Given the values:
 
 
• National Income = ₹ 1,000
 
• Corporate Tax = ₹ 10
 
• Subsidy = ₹ 5
 
• Undistributed Profit = ₹ 15
 
 
 
• Substituting the values into the formula:
 
 
• Personal Income = ₹ 1,000 - ₹ 10 - ₹ 15 + ₹ 5
 
• Personal Income = ₹ 980
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **₹ 980**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Personal income is an important economic indicator that represents the total income received by individuals in a country from all sources, including wages, salaries, and other forms of income.
 
• It is a measure of the purchasing power of the population and can influence economic policies and decisions.
 
• Understanding personal income helps in assessing the overall economic health and standard of living of a nation.
 
• It is different from National Income, which is the total income earned by a nation's residents and businesses, including any income from abroad.
